scope: Local PDF underlays, vector and rotated/cropped scanned pages, per-page calibration and overlays, measurements, camera editing, cable flags, full-document PDF export, source protection and reopening; existing DWG and DXF read paths. Synthetic PDF fixture contains no customer data.

checks: Open a local PDF with pages and no assumed drawing scale
Calibrate a 200-point reference segment to 10 metres
PDF zoom and middle-button panning preserve geometry and stop on release
Existing multi-segment measurements use calibrated PDF units
Draw cables with length flags and place named cameras on PDF
Rotated and cropped scanned page opens with independent overlays and scale
Set a printed scale and add Polish text on a scanned PDF
Page navigation restores saved calibration and correct page objects
Cmd+S saves all PDF pages with their installation overlays
Saved PDF reopens as a self-contained document without local project data
Reopening the original PDF restores the editable project
Export cannot overwrite the original PDF
Cancelling PDF save preserves the editable project
Switching back to CAD restores its original controls
Existing DWG reader still opens native CAD geometry

independentPdfChecks.pypdf: Two pages, page rotation/crop and Polish exported labels confirmed
independentPdfChecks.poppler: Both exported pages rendered and visually inspected; cable alignment, camera, flag, Polish text and rotated scan checked

limitations: Full DWG/DXF export regression could not run because ODA File Converter was not installed. Previous 1.3.3 export verification is historical, not a 1.4.0 result.
No phone, Intel Mac or exhaustive arbitrary PDF compatibility test.
